results.notDeliveredBecause: The run_card host IS declared and drawn (AgenticRunPanel wraps its body in LifecycleCardSurfaceProvider host="run_card"), and a REAL review gate is now bound to this run - the run's own step rail draws it (Review CHANGES_REQUESTED / Core analysis DRIFTED). The card still does not mount because the panel gates the run_card ReviewGateCard on the run being PAUSED at the artifact-review HITL step: isPendingApproval && effectiveHitlContext?.xRenderer === ARTIFACT_REVIEW_REDIRECT_RENDERER_ID && reviewGateCardRef. That interrupt context is live orchestration state, not a row, so it needs an LLM-backed run that actually reaches the review checkpoint - unreachable on this credential-free host.
